English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us Don’t fall for the fake application form of the Korean Language Exam. False The call for applications related to the Korean language exam in the year 2024 is currently taking place and an application stating that it is from the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment is currently circulating in the social media. by Anonymous | February 21, 2024 It says that “Korean EPS Topic Exam – Pre-Survey for Applicants Looking to Apply for 2024 – Applicants looking to take the exam are required to provide information for this pre-survey.” Further the official logo of the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment has also been included. Since many people are interested in this matter, Fact Seeker asked the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment about this application. Accordingly, the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment emphasized that the application form is currently circulating on the Internet, is a fake application form that is not related with the Korean language exam. Also, the Korean HRDK institute has officially confirmed that this exam application is completely fake and the bureau requested you to refrain from giving your information to the fake google form. Candidates who wish to appear for the 2024 Korean Exam can refer to the Korean EPS Exam Instructions published on the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment website and only instructions related to the application have been published there. Further the official application form will be published only on http://www.slbfe.lk/ from February 26 to 29. Moreover Mr. Madushan Kularatne, Head of the Media Section of the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment stated that more information can be obtained by contacting 1989. Mr. Madushan Kularatne further stated that so far the Foreign Employment Bureau has not issued any google form application. Accordingly, Fact Sekeer confirms that the application form is fake.
